newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian money market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian money market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian interbank money market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
On Friday, the overnight interbank rate closed at 8.7 percent on heavy borrowing by big domestic commercial banks.
Other interbank rates were easier as the market adjusted to the higher liquidity that came into the system two days ago.

One-week money was at 6.90/7.00 percent against 7.10/15, two-week was at 7.00/15 against 7.15/20 and one-month at 7.18/21 against 7.20/23. Three-month rate was at 7.20/25 percent against 7.23/25 and six-month at 7.27/30 against 7.28/35.
